notes: The source URL and catalog text are for the Heavy/Medium Duty Truck Technology Associate of Science Degree, not the requested Certificate of Achievement. The text describes 'the ... degree', lists Cal-GETC/SBVC GE patterns for an Associate Degree, and prints Total Units 31, which exceeds the certificate's 16 to fewer than 30 unit range. The certificate's own section (listed in the page menu as 'Heavy/Medium Duty Truck Technology Certificate of Achievement') is not in the text, so no blocks, totals, outcomes or careers were recorded for it.

For reference, the A.S. degree section lists Required Courses: CIT 101 (3), HMDT 021, 022, 023, 024, 026, 028 (4 each), HMDT 064 or AUTO 064 (4); Total Units 31; Recommended Courses: HMDT 098 (0.5-4), WELD 010 (2). CIT 101 and WELD 010 are not on the closed list. The certificate likely omits CIT 101 (27 units), but this is not stated in the text and should be verified against the certificate page.

The Program Learning Outcomes printed on this page belong to the A.S. degree page (one includes transfer to a four-year college with junior standing); they were not recorded for the certificate. Reviewer should check whether the certificate page prints the same outcomes.
The degree description names employment in 'maintenance and repair of heavy/medium duty trucks'; not recorded as careers since it belongs to the degree section.
